incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT: Elevated 502/504 rates observed in northbridge region (nb1-edge). Paging oncall-sre-1 and netops. See alert: high-5xx-nb1-1764202468

oncall-sre-1: acked. I'm awake, pulling graphs and logs now. ETA 2m.

maya (SRE): I'm online too. Seeing a sharp spike at 12:07 UTC, 502 rate ~32% on edge-proxy tier. Upstream app pods show normal 200s.

raj (eng-runtime): curious — are these synthetic requests or real user traffic? Any pattern by route/model?

oncall-sre-1: looks concentrated on /v1/generate and /v1/chat. Token-level latencies spike, then 502 returned from proxy. Retries surge.

owen (netops): I'm checking NAT/egress. If proxies can't establish outbound connections they can 502. Pulling net metrics.

emily (prod-ops): customers starting to file error spikes to support. Prioritizing communication.

oncall-sre-1: quick sanity: kvcache hit ratios stable (~88%). Redis latency fine. Edge proxy logs show a lot of `connection reset by peer` to upstream pool.

raj (eng-runtime): can you paste sample proxy log lines?

oncall-sre-1: pasted:
```
2026-05-09T12:07:32Z nb1-edge-01 proxy[pid=2034]: upstream_request failed: conn reset by peer, id=0x3f2a, route=/v1/generate, backend=app-v2-7f9df
2026-05-09T12:07:33Z nb1-edge-02 proxy[pid=1987]: upstream_request failed: timeout waiting for socket, id=0x3f3b, backend=app-v2-7f9df
```

maya (SRE): that `conn reset` plus `timeout waiting for socket` points at either upstream overload or network exhaustion. Owen, what do NAT ephemeral ports look like?

owen (netops): checking SNAT ephemeral port pool for nb1 egress. Counters: ephemeral_inuse=65278/65536 (99.6%), TIME_WAIT backlog rising. Looks like ephemeral port exhaustion.

emily (prod-ops): oh that'd match the symptom — proxies try to open new outbound sockets and get resets/timeouts. Customer-facing 502s.

raj (eng-runtime): why the sudden jump? Did something change in connection reuse / keepalive behavior? Any deploys?

oncall-sre-1: no deploys in last 30m per deploy-bot. Last config rollback earlier this morning.

maya (SRE): quick mitigation plan: 1) throttle/reduce outgoing new connections by increasing keepalive and reusing sockets, 2) steer a portion of traffic to eu-west-1 as failover, 3) scale up northbridge egress NAT pool if cloud provider allows, 4) notify customers and update status.

owen (netops): opening cloud support ticket for additional SNAT addresses. Requesting +1024 ports now, but that takes ~8-12 min to provision. Meanwhile we can try traffic steering and aggressive connection reuse.

oncall-sre-1: I'll push a temporary proxy config to increase keepalive time and max idle connections to reuse sockets. Rolling to nb1-edge set.

raj (eng-runtime): push the config snippet here before roll and I'll sanity-check.

oncall-sre-1: snippet:
```
proxy.tcp_keepalive = true
proxy.keepalive_idle = 300
proxy.max_idle_conns = 5000
proxy.reuse_connections = true
```
Rolling to 3/3 edge pods in nb1 now.

maya (SRE): also initiating a gradual traffic steer: 20% -> eu-west-1 for read-heavy routes and non-critical tenants. Tim, can you authorize the steer?

tim (platform): authorize. Use canary thresholds: if 5xx in target <=1% after 3m, proceed to 50%.

emily (prod-ops): drafting status message: "We are investigating elevated 5xx errors in northbridge. Partial regional impact; mitigation in progress. We'll update in 15 minutes."

oncall-sre-1: keepalive config completed, pod restarts done. Early signs: new_conn rate down ~60%, ephemeral_inuse fell to 88%. 502 rate dropping to 12%.

owen (netops): cloud support responded: provisioning extra SNAT IPs, ETA 9m. I'll monitor.

raj (eng-runtime): good. Any error patterns by tenant?

oncall-sre-1: heavy tenants with many short-lived streaming connections saw biggest blowup. Likely client-side connection churn amplified by retries.

maya (SRE): recommend also pushing back on retries at edge for 502s — short-circuit some client retries to avoid amplification until stable.

oncall-sre-1: reducing retry multiplier from 3 to 1 for nb1. Rolling now.

emily (prod-ops): support update posted. Customers hit: ~14 high-volume tenants reported degraded service, impact severity P2.

oncall-sre-1: after retry change + keepalive, steady state: 5xx ~2.1%, ephemeral_inuse 55k/65k (~84%). Error tail reduced.

owen (netops): SNAT IPs added, ephemeral_inuse capacity increased to 95k. Monitoring.

raj (eng-runtime): can we run a small synthetic canary in nb1 to verify end-to-end?

oncall-sre-1: running canary: 100 requests to /v1/generate, success=99/100, p95 latency within baseline.

maya (SRE): great. Step-down plan: keep failover active at 20% for 10m, then roll to normal if stable. Also schedule a post-incident dedupe: fix long-term by enabling improved connection pooling and revisiting client SDK retry jitter.

emily (prod-ops): I'll prepare the customer summary and follow-up notes.

oncall-sre-1: handing off to maya for postmortem. I'm going offline for on-call break.

maya (SRE): taking over. I'll run full RCA, collect kernel-level TIME_WAIT dumps, and draft mitigation roadmap. Final note: total impacted requests ~1.8M over 25m window, peak error rate 32%, resolved to baseline in ~18m.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: northbridge proxy chain 5xx spike mitigated. Ticket #INC-1764202468 closed (status: resolved).

emily (prod-ops): Thanks team. I'll schedule follow-up postmortem and customer comms. :thumbsup:
